MPC excitation mode and MRAC numeric widget widths
==================================================

- MPC now offers Random Steps and Alternating Steps for the unrestricted initial identification excitation.
- Random Steps use blockwise N(0,1) values.
- Alternating Steps use deterministic +1, -1, +1, -1, ... values.
- No Legacy option was added to MPC.
- MRAC numeric input widgets were shortened to the same compact width style used in MPC.
